query:
SELECT
                    id,
                    dni,
                    first_name,
                    last_name,
                    email,
                    gender AS "gender:Gender",
                    phone,
                    address,
                    (
                        SELECT u.avatar FROM users u
                        WHERE u.student_id = students.id AND u.avatar <> ''
                        LIMIT 1
                    ) AS avatar,
                    created_at,
                    updated_at
                FROM students
                WHERE $1::TEXT IS NULL
                    OR (first_name || ' ' || last_name) ILIKE $1
                    OR email ILIKE $1
                    OR dni::TEXT ILIKE $1
                ORDER BY last_name, first_name, id
                LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3
